description: The shortcut for "free avatars" / "avatares grátis": shows ONLY the free Ania avatars in the interactive gallery, plus a short id list for apps without the gallery and the public page that lists them. Then get_free (listing_id, type "avatar") puts the one the user picked in their library at no cost. Optional search text and category slug. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
